_about: Training questions for the scope check (app/core/scope.py, scripts/train_scope.py): is a question about an offence under the Indian Penal Code (1) or not (0)? Written by Claude on 2026-10-13. None of these appear in the evaluation sets (docs/eval/*, scripts/calibrate_retrieval.py), which are kept separate to measure the check fairly.
